resources.string: Nothing is recorded until you switch it on here. Each log is written as plain text into the app\'s own directory — /sdcard/Android/data/shiroikuma.ongaku/files/diag/ — and never as a .log file, because EMUI\'s nightly clean-up deletes those.

Every screen created and destroyed, with whether it was a fold or a rotation. Each destroyed screen is then watched by a weak reference and checked again after a forced collection: still reachable means it leaked, and the line says RETAINED.
Once a minute: resident size, the Java, native and graphics splits, and how many screens and media controllers the process is holding.
Play, pause and stop, track changes, seeks, and every time the queue is set or replaced.
The player service starting and stopping, and every media controller built, reused, released or disconnected.
Library scans — when they start, how long they take and what they found.
Automation intents from 自由作業盤 and 応用管理, and whether each one was let in.
Copies everything into a dated subdirectory of a directory you pick. Offered at /sdcard/tmp first.
Hands the files straight to another app.
There is nothing to share yet
Deletes every recorded file, after asking.
This deletes %1$d files, %2$s in all, covering %3$s. They are gone for good — export or share them first if any of it still matters.
